methodology.gtfs_snapshot_note: The official NJ TRANSIT rail_data.zip archive downloaded on 2026-08-26 contained route, trip, stop-time, shape, and stop files timestamped 2026-08-19 17:12.
included_fields: official GTFS route membership within the four displayed route groups

methodology.selection_note: The interface presents a documented station selection across four route groups and does not represent the complete NJ TRANSIT rail system. Riders are directed to NJ TRANSIT for date-specific itineraries, transfers, fares, alerts, parking, and accessibility information.
